historicalRoutes.name: Čaven Trail
historicalRoutes.summary: Loop from Lokavec climbing through forest to Koča Antona Bavčerja on Čaven, continuing along the ridge to Kucelj before descending and returning to Lokavec. The route combines a steep forest ascent, exposed ridge sections and a descending trail back to the village.
highlights: views over the Vipava Valley, Karst and Gulf of Trieste
historicalRoutes.catering: Official rules describe food and drink at aid stations; participants must be self-sufficient between checkpoints. Bottles are topped up only with water or energy drink; no aid-station menu by route is published in the accessible page.
mandatoryEquipment: additional bad-weather equipment may be required

historicalRoutes.name: Čaven Vertikal
historicalRoutes.summary: A direct, steep vertical ascent from Lokavec to Koča Antona Bavčerja on Čaven. The route is described by the organiser as a vertical kilometre, with almost continuous climbing over a short distance.
historicalRoutes.catering: Two refreshment points are listed: km 2.4 and the finish. No itemised menu published.

historicalRoutes.name: Čaven Vrh
historicalRoutes.summary: Mountain loop from Lokavec through forest to Koča Antona Bavčerja, then along the ridge to Kucelj and westwards across Veliki rob and Čaven to Sekulak. The route returns east beneath the ridge and descends to Lokavec, with sustained high-level views over the Vipava Valley, Karst and Gulf of Trieste.
highlights: Vipava Valley and Gulf of Trieste views
historicalRoutes.catering: Official rules list food and drink at refreshment stations and two water points. Participants must be self-sufficient between stations.

2026 routes are historical only. The event page says the 2026 edition was moved from 24 October to 21 November due to weather and mountain-rescue safety advice.

Official pages embed Trace de Trail iframes, but direct route pages were not accessible in this review. No GPX download link or explicit GPX restriction notice was found in accessible page text; no GPX binary was downloaded and no metadata was inspected.

No separate official email address for Triatlon klub GPS was found. The official event contact info@caven.run is verified; request asks the event mailbox to forward to both joint organisers and identify rights holders.

rights.autoResponseSummary: The published info@caven.run mailbox automatically discards incoming email and directs correspondents to the S1 Trail contact page and WhatsApp assistant; no human rights decision received.
